notes: 74HC165, NOT LVC. ADR 0001 said so in passing and then chose otherwise: LVC's 'better drive over a 14in chain' is backwards, because over an unterminated line faster edges are what cause reflections. HC's slow edges keep each hop - a ribbon and part of the main board - an ordinary LUMPED LOAD rather than a transmission line. Same SOIC-16; LVC with proper source termination is the way back if E4 disagrees. ONE PER CLUSTER: right_thumb and left_thumb on the main board, right_hand and left_hand on the key boards (ADR 0017). Tie CLK INH low at all four. AT 3.3 V THE VENDOR MATTERS: prefer Nexperia (claims JESD8C 2.7-3.6 V) or onsemi (publishes a 3.0 V threshold row); a TI SN74HC165 guarantees nothing at 3.3 V and falls back to key-release-time's conservative_bound. If the board house offers a substitute at order time, hold it to this. The bought part is the sheet's (ADR 0019)
